description: This file defines a Rect class with geometry utility methods for handling rectangular areas, including containment checks, intersection calculations, and construction from various parameters. It also exports types and imports a Point-related utility.

classes.name: Rect
classes.description: A class representing a rectangle with methods for geometric operations such as containment, intersection, and construction from points or DOM elements.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if the rectangle is equal to another rectangle based on their top, left, bottom, and right coordinates.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Determines if a point or rectangle is contained within this rectangle. For points, returns an object indicating if the point is on the sides. For rectangles, returns a boolean.

methods.name: intersectsWith
methods.description: Checks if this rectangle intersects with another rectangle.
